staff.name: Matthew Hagan
staff.title: Editor and publisher
staff.bio: Matthew Hagan has followed the MAC since his Ohio University days (Class of 2001). He founded Hardwood Bricks in Northeast Ohio for the 2026-27 season, writes its Fieldhouse Notes and shoots its arena photos.

media.in_person: Home games in Northeast Ohio (Akron, Kent State, Cleveland State and Youngstown State) and the MAC tournament in Cleveland. Other venues only when a trip is planned, and the request says so.

_note: Fill these in as they go live; blank fields are hidden. staff: everyone on the masthead page (bio is one or two sentences; photo is a path like static/staff/matthew-hagan.jpg (files live in templates/static/staff/, 4:5 portrait), shown in black and white). conference_editors: a name per edition key; blank means the editor above is acting editor. x handles without the @. media: the Media page (media.html) for SIDs reviewing credential requests. in_person is where the editor covers games in the building. samples is an optional hand-picked list of {"title", "href", "kind"} (href relative to the site root, e.g. "notes.html#n-<file>"); empty shows the newest recaps and previews.
